1/*


2 * A small but representative AngelScript module: namespaces, classes


3 * with constructors, properties and operators, interfaces, enums,


4 * funcdefs, templates, handles, lambdas and every statement kind.


5 */


6namespace Game {


7    enum Team { Red, Blue = 2, Neutral }


8


9    funcdef void Callback(int value);


10


11    const int MAX_UNITS = 12;


12    int created = 0;


13


14    interface IDamageable {


15        void takeDamage(float amount);


16    }


17


18    shared class Unit : IDamageable {


19        private float hp;


20        Team team;


21


22        Unit(float startHp, Team t = Team::Red) {


23            hp = startHp;


24            team = t;


25            created++;


26        }


27


28        ~Unit() {}


29


30        float health {


31            get const { return hp; }


32            set { hp = value < 0 ? 0 : value; }


33        }


34


35        void takeDamage(float amount) override {


36            hp -= amount;


37        }


38


39        bool opEquals(const Unit@ other) const {


40            return other !is null && other.team == team;


41        }


42    }


43}


44


45array<Game::Unit@>@ units = array<Game::Unit@>();


46


47int countAlive(const array<Game::Unit@>& in list) {


48    int alive = 0;


49    for (uint i = 0; i < list.length(); i++) {


50        if (list[i] is null) {


51            continue;


52        }


53        if (list[i].health > 0.0f) {


54            alive += 1;


55        }


56    }


57    return alive;


58}


59


60void each(Game::Callback@ cb) {


61    for (int i = 0; i < Game::MAX_UNITS; ++i) {


62        cb(i);


63    }


64}


65


66string describe(Game::Team team) {


67    switch (team) {


68    case Game::Team::Red:


69        return "red";


70    case Game::Team::Blue:


71        return "blue";


72    default:


73        return "neutral";


74    }


75}


76


77void main() {


78    Game::Unit@ u = Game::Unit(100.0f);


79    units.insertLast(u);


80    u.takeDamage(25.5f);


81    int total = 0;


82    each(function(v) { total += v; });


83    while (total > 0) {


84        total = total - 2 ** 3;


85    }


86    do {


87        total++;


88    } while (total < 3);


89    try {


90        print(describe(Game::Team::Blue) + ": " + countAlive(units) + "\n");


91    } catch {


92        print("failed\n");


93    }


94}
